quest.title: Theater Mechanicus: Stage of Brilliance
quest.description: Inazuma's Komakata is promoting the latest version of Theater Mechanicus during the Irodori Festival...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventurer's Experience x2, Wanderer's Advice x4

dialogues.speaker: Komakata
dialogues.text: Come, try your hand at the all-new version of Theater Mechanicus!

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: It's a tabletop game from Liyue, and a very interesting one, too!

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: The original inventor of the game is Ms. Ruijin from Liyue, and she gave me the overseas franchising rights to the game, such that I'd be able to distribute it in Inazuma.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: I've been in correspondence with her about ways in which we might improve Theater Mechanicus.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: And just as luck would have it, the release of our new ruleset coincided with news that the Magnificent Irodori Festival was going to be held.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: A short while after deciding to take part in the exhibition, I heard that some big shot would be attending to assess the business prospects of Theater Mechanicus.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: That got me pumped right up! I mean, I hope everyone gets to play the best Theater Mechanicus possible.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Would you like to have a go at Theater Mechanicus: Stage of Brilliance?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: "Stage of Brilliance"?

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Long story short, this is Theater Mechanicus' latest and greatest playstyle, which draws inspiration from the "endgame" phase of Liyue chess games.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: When each new board for Stage of Brilliance opens, there will already be some devices present on the field.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Players must analyze the situation and figure out how to use these devices and carefully ponder stratagems that might be used to achieve victory.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: The pace of Stage of Brilliance is faster than those of previous versions, all the better to test the players' judgment. It'll be a sore test and no mistake!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, let's have at it, then.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: I hope that the Stage of Brilliance will meet your expectations!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Try Theater Mechanicus.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Oh-ho! So you do remember me, huh?

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Ah, it was all thanks to your ingenious strategies that I realized just how much more room Theater Mechanicus has left to improve.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: When the Stage of Wonders promotional event ended, I wrote to Ruijin to share my views with her.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: I never thought that we'd be on the exact same page! I guess I'm a pretty good "overseas franchise owner," eh? Hehehe...

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Either way, after some back and forth between us, we've come up with the newest version of Theater Mechanicus, which we call the "Stage of Brilliance."

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: It draws inspiration from the "endgame" phase of Liyue chess games.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: When each new board for Stage of Brilliance opens, there will already be some devices present on the field.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Players must analyze the situation and figure out how to use these devices and carefully ponder stratagems that might be used to achieve victory.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: The pace of Stage of Brilliance is faster than those of previous versions, all the better to test the players' judgment. It'll be a sore test and no mistake!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That does sound interesting.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: I know, right? I can't wait to see how our customers react after playing.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: I think I've finally gotten the hang of being a franchise owner after all this time. As such, I'd like to use this Irodori Festival as an opportunity to get more people acquainted with this game.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: I've even heard that some big shot will be attending to assess its business prospects, so this might be our chance to make it big! Or at least, that's what I hope.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: So, how about it? Why not give the Stage of Brilliance a go?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Try Theater Mechanicus.
